body.prompt: Exactly the same miniature diorama, same camera angle, same framing, same composition and same objects as the reference image, but during a violent Florida summer thunderstorm. Dark slate-blue storm clouds fill the top of the frame, heavy rain streaks, wet glossy ground with puddles, a bright forked lightning bolt striking in the distance behind the stacks, cool blue-grey light, the cream background turned stormy dark grey-blue. The tiny workers are walking toward the turbine hall door for shelter. Windows glow warm. Same tilt-shift miniature photography style. No text, no logos.
